summary: Iteration 4 validated the Automatic Indicator Calculation Engine extension. Backend: 17/17 new pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_calc_engine.py covering: safe formula engine (IF() zero-guard giving 95.0 and 0 for zero-denominator; bad formula returns 'Kesalahan formula' note not 500); all calc types (percentage 95.0, manual 77.0, composite 85.0); target_direction higher_is_better (achievement 105.56, TERCAPAI), lower_is_better (125.0, TERCAPAI), exact_target (95.0, BELUM TERCAPAI); achievement_threshold configurable (threshold=80 → 95% becomes TERCAPAI); manual override by super_admin preserves original_result, requires reason (400 without), viewer 403; recalculate-all returns {count, errors}; history retains both automatic and override records; GET /api/health returns {application, database:'ok', sipp, version, server_time}; POST/PUT /api/indicators persists all new fields (target_direction, realization_source, formula, variables_def, decimal_precision, zero_denominator_behavior, achievement_threshold, allow_override) and GET returns them. Frontend: login → dashboard OK; IndicatorForm 'Lanjutan' tab shows form-realization-source, form-target-direction, form-zero-denominator, form-threshold (all visible); Perhitungan page renders 'Capaian' column with values (106.25%, 96.25%, 125%, 105.56%, etc.), correct achievement_status badges (TERCAPAI / BELUM TERCAPAI / N/A). Zero console errors during the whole flow. No backend or frontend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1172 lines — modularization into routers (auth/indicators/data/calc/sipp/health/users) is overdue.

In /api/calculations/override, `original_result` is taken from the most-recent calc even if that most-recent record is itself an override — chaining overrides may lose the true original automatic value. Consider filtering to the latest non-override calc when populating original_result.

Health endpoint reports `sipp` from cached `last_status` field in system_settings; it is not a live probe. Acceptable for MVP but rename to `sipp_last_status` or perform a lightweight live check for accuracy.

compute_achievement returns None for target=0 and for lower_is_better with realization=0. Silent None flows through to N/A — fine, but a clearer note in the calculation record would help UI (currently just shows N/A).
